title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions. This issue arises from improper restriction of rendered UI layers or frames, potentially enabling unauthorized access to certain interface elements or functions. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.6.
